name: Plaza Las Brisas
summary: Plaza Las Brisas is an enduring, renovated open-air shopping center in Tijuana's Las Brisas neighborhood, featuring chain retailers, local services, and casual dining options. Operating daily from 7 AM to 10 PM, this community-focused destination serves both local residents and cross-border shoppers along Boulevard Gustavo Díaz Ordaz.
demographics: Plaza Las Brisas serves the Las Brisas neighborhood of Tijuana, attracting middle-income Mexican families and cross-border shoppers from San Diego. The primary trade area consists of working professionals, young families, and students seeking convenient access to everyday retail, dining, and services. Visitors typically range from ages 25-54 with moderate household incomes, prioritizing value and convenience in their shopping patterns. The center benefits from high foot traffic due to its strategic location on Boulevard Gustavo Díaz Ordaz, drawing both local residents and international visitors.
description: Plaza Las Brisas stands as an enduring landmark in Tijuana's Las Brisas neighborhood, offering a renovated open-air shopping experience along Boulevard Gustavo Díaz Ordaz. Since its establishment, this community-focused center has served generations of local families and cross-border shoppers with a diverse mix of chain retailers, local services, and casual eateries. The plaza's thoughtful renovation has modernized the facility while maintaining its accessible, neighborhood-oriented character that residents have come to rely upon. With organized sections spanning food services, auto services, beauty and health, home and electronics, restaurants, clothing and accessories, financial services, telecommunications, and offices, Plaza Las Brisas functions as a comprehensive retail destination. Operating daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM, the center's convenient hours and strategic location make it a vital commercial hub for the surrounding community, earning strong ratings from thousands of satisfied visitors.
